name: Helmet Cam
author: Sedz
description:
The cockpit camera as seen from inside a helmet: the eye port's edges, the brow padding, a tinted visor with smudges and your team's visor strip, plus head sway under braking and cornering and road vibration. The helmet stays still while the world moves, like a real visor cam.

Only the cockpit camera changes, and the HUD stays on top and untouched. Turn it off and the game's camera is exactly as before. Works with Driver Display.

options.label: Helmet view
options.description: Turns the whole helmet view on and off in game.

options.label: Helmet edge
options.description: How dark the edges of the helmet's eye port get, from none at 0.

options.label: Brow padding
options.description: How far the helmet's padding comes down across the top of the view, from none at 0.

options.label: Visor smudges
options.description: Faint smears on the visor that catch the light, from a clean visor at 0.

options.label: Visor strip
options.description: Your team's strip across the top of the visor, from none at 0. Each team has its own strip.

options.label: Strip seen from inside (mirrored)
options.description: The strip is on the outside of the visor, so from inside its print reads back to front. Off shows it readable.

options.label: Head movement: braking
options.description: How much the view dips under braking and lifts under acceleration, from none at 0.

options.label: Head movement: cornering
options.description: How much the view tilts and looks into corners, from none at 0.

options.label: Road vibration
options.description: A fine shake that grows with speed, from none at 0.

options.label: Aston Martin Mode
options.description: In the 2026 Aston Martin, the road vibration is 300 %, and the Road vibration slider can't turn it down. Other cars are unchanged.

options.label: Visor rain
options.description: Rain drops on the visor, blown off to the sides at speed. Auto follows the game's weather (needs the game's UDP telemetry on); Always shows it in any weather, to try it.

options.label: Visor rain amount
options.description: How many drops at the heaviest rain, from none at 0.

options.label: Toggle key
options.description: A key that turns the helmet view on and off while you drive.

options.label: Camera height
options.description: Moves every car's cockpit camera down from the game's own eye position, to sit where a helmet camera would. Applies at the next launch.

options.label: Camera side
options.description: Moves every car's cockpit camera 2 cm to one side, like a camera in the helmet's padding. Applies at the next launch.

options.label: Head turn into corners
options.description: Turns the game's own cockpit camera a little towards the corner while you're under cornering load. Lane changes and small corrections don't move it. 0 turns it off; your own look buttons always win.

options.label: Camera probe (test build)
options.description: Logs what the game's free-look camera does, for the next version's real head movement. Changes nothing in game.
